definitions.sourceCoveredCandidate: All named subject elements for the requirement have a rights-clear reusable evidence route in the current prototype; production quality is not implied.
definitions.partial: Commercially reusable subject evidence exists for a substantial part of the requirement, but one or more named elements still need targeted sourcing or bounded synthesis.
definitions.gap: No current commercial-compatible reusable source route has yet been established for the named requirement.
definitions.sourceSupported: sourceCoveredCandidate + partial; means the requirement is not being built from zero, not that it is complete.

options.difficultOptionClosure: Forensic Psychology improved from 1 covered / 3 partial to 3 covered / 1 partial after targeted rights-clear evidence and alignment reconciliation.

economics.elapsedWorkingTime: not reliably measurable retrospectively across multi-chat governed execution
manualWorkObserved: official course-scope extraction and paraphrase into stable requirement IDs

singleRemainingGap.reason: The model is easy to locate factually, but convenient explanatory sources inspected so far use non-commercial licences. Original scholarly records confirm the model but have not been promoted to OPEN reusable corpus without a commercial-compatible rights basis.

narrowRightsResidual.reason: A highly relevant 2026 forensic-inpatient study is openly available under a Creative Commons licence, but accessible metadata did not establish the exact licence flavour. It remains uncounted until commercial compatibility is verified.

interpretation.positiveSignal: 117/118 named requirements already have some commercial-compatible reusable subject evidence. Targeted difficult-option work also moved two Forensic requirements from partial to source-covered without paid generation.
interpretation.importantLimit: Only 56/118 are source-complete candidates at the current threshold. Sixty-one source-supported requirements still need named-element synthesis or targeted source closure; 99.2% source support is not 99.2% finished Foundation coverage.
interpretation.specialistSignal: Options are more fragmented than the compulsory representative topic, but targeted searching can close specialist residuals. The likely production bottleneck is source orchestration and rights verification rather than absence of reusable subject truth.
interpretation.nextProof: Verify/resolve the token-economy rights residual and decide whether the Prochaska gap is best solved by a new OPEN source, a licensed source or a narrowly governed original bridge. Then build one difficult-option structured Foundation slice to measure transformation cost.
